description: This file defines utility functions related to motion preferences and transitions in a web application, including detecting user's reduced motion setting, providing default motion tokens, and creating transition styles.

methods.name: shouldReduceMotion
methods.description: Checks if the user's OS or browser has reduced motion enabled.

methods.name: motionTokens
methods.description: Provides default motion timing values and easing for animations.

methods.name: transitionStyle
methods.description: Creates a style object for transitions, respecting the user's reduced motion setting.
